title: A sound stream: data/sound/streams/<category>/<name>/data.json
description: A stream's info record in the sound archive (swan_sound_data.sdat), which tools/data/sound_data.py packs in the order of data/constants/sound_streams.txt. Its audio is stream.wav beside it, 8-bit or 16-bit PCM, mono or stereo (tools/data/strm.py).

file.description: The stream whose file this one plays

player.description: The stream player that plays it

loop_start.description: For a stream that loops, the sample its loop starts at; it loops to its end

timer.description: The stream's timer, where it isn't its rate's (16756991 divided by the rate, then by 32)
